verdict.rationale:
CodeRabbit ships several background automations that need no manual trigger: auto-review on PR events with configurable rules (branch/label/draft skip) [coderabbit-docs-21], CI/CD failure analysis that auto-posts fixes [coderabbit-docs-44], scheduled Triage digests delivered to Slack [coderabbit-docs-36], one-click 'finishing touches' agentic actions [coderabbit-docs-13], and PR validation/slop detection running automatically [coderabbit-docs-45, coderabbit-docs-46]. These qualify as autonomous background automations in the code-review domain.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that these automations run reliably unattended over time, and clearer detail on scheduling/triggering configuration beyond PR/CI events (e.g., cron-like independent agent runs).
